title: Nutritious Australian Lamb Casserole
description: A comforting and nutritious Australian dish featuring lamb, sunflower oil, and low-calorie ingredients, cooked to perfection in a ttukbaegi earthenware pot.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 300 degrees Fahrenheit.
Heat the sunflower oil in the ttukbaegi earthenware pot over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the lamb pieces and cook until browned, about 5 minutes.
Add the chopped carrots and zucchini and cook for an additional 2 minutes.
Stir in the tomato paste, chicken broth, salt, and black pepper.
Bring the mixture to a boil, then cover the pot and transfer to the preheated oven.
Bake for 1 hour and 30 minutes, or until the lamb is tender and the vegetables are cooked through.
Remove the pot from the oven and let it cool for 10 minutes before serving.
